body:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: NEW INCIDENT - pager #4332 - elevated routing errors and content format regressions in eu-central-1 (auto-detect)

amar: ack. i'm taking lead. @oncall-ams can you join and shadow? also alerting SRE lead.

nora: joining. initial glance shows error rate jump around 09:14 UTC. lots of 502/formatting-failures on /v1/chat and /v1/generate

diego: quick Q - any deploys in the last hour in eu-central? CI shows a model deploy to dedicated pools at 08:50 but not to hosted.

amar: no hosted deploys. telemetry snapshot: 5m err% = 9.8% (normal ~0.3). p95 latency climbed from 220ms -> 950ms for affected routes.

qa-bot: failing_tests: 7 unit tests in fallback-mapper (tokenization-aware) flagged; two new flaky tests in compatibility suite.

nora: copying timeline raw snippets from query:
```
09:12:37 eu-central-1 router: route selection queue depth increasing
09:13:05 eu-central-1 autoscaler: scale-up triggered, but new nodes provisioning delayed
09:13:50 routing-engine: fallback chosen: rw-2a-lite for several premium requests (expected family: rw-2b)
09:14:02 customer-reports: parse errors in payloads, misformatted JSON
09:14:35 support: open tickets from 3 enterprise customers in EU region
```

amar: key observation: the router chose a smaller "lit" variant (rw-2a-lite) as fallback for some premium traffic. that model uses a slightly different instruction prefix and light-quantized tokenizer. leads to missing EOL tokens in chat completions and parser errors at caller side.

diego: why would router prefer rw-2a-lite? config snippet shows this fallback preference uses 'min_latency' score and doesn't weigh tokenizer compatibility. past PR removed compatibility weight to reduce latency for burst scenarios.

nora: hypothesis list up front:
- H1: capacity pressure causing fallback
- H2: fallback scoring undervalues model-family/tokenizer compatibility
- H3: autoscaler cold-starts too slow for dedicated pool growth
- H4: tier constraints not enforced for some premium routes (policy drift)

amar: mitigation plan (live):
1) temporarily pin premium flows in eu-central to dedicated-hosted pool alias eu-central-reserved (if capacity). If insufficient, route to us-east-1 dedicated as second option (with customer opt-out note).
2) rollback the recent fallback-scoring tweak or add immediate override to prefer same-family candidates for premium.
3) reduce concurrency for non-premium traffic to reclaim capacity.

nora: running policy change to add family-preference override for premium now. command:
```
PATCH /internal/routing/policies HTTP/1.1
Host: console.internal.redwood
Authorization: Bearer ***
Content-Type: application/json
{ "change": { "id": "policy-913-override", "scope": "tier:premium,region:eu-central-1", "fallback_preference": "prefer_same_family", "spillover": "disabled" }}
```

ops-bot: policy applied: change-id policy-913-override (tx:0x9f1b). propagation started.

qa-bot: running quick tokenization diff tests between rw-2b and rw-2a-lite on sample prompts. small but impactful boundary differences observed on punctuation and newline handling.

diego: policy change shows immediate effect in router logs: selection of rw-2a-lite for premium down 95% within 30s. error rate dropping 9.8% -> 1.6% in 3m for premium.

amar: good. support, please prepare customer comms: short note, impact, mitigation applied, ETA for root-cause and full RCA. include support tickets list.

support-bot: compiling top impacted customers last 60m: cust_omega, cust_beta, cust-nova, plus 8 others. CSV link: https://internal.redwood/support/export/4332.csv

nora: drafting post-incident items inline: ensure fallback-scoring includes tokenizer-family compatibility weight, roll out test harness to catch tokenizer mismatches, add canary for policy changes, and tune autoscaler for faster prewarm.

diego: quick experiment to verify H2: re-run routing-sim with previous and current scoring. results: when latency weight > 0.6, family_score often ignored; that produced ~13% incompatible fallbacks in traces.

amar: decided fixes (short-term):
- keep policy-913-override pinned for 45m and monitor
- throttle non-premium burst to free up slots
- create CR to revert scoring PR and add compatibility tests (owner: diego)

nora: timeline build so far:
- 09:11:50 - small traffic surge observed in eu-central
- 09:12:20 - queue depth increases
- 09:13:05 - autoscaler triggered but delayed (cloud API latency)
- 09:13:50 - fallback-scoring picks rw-2a-lite in many premium cases
- 09:14:02 - customers report parse/format errors
- 09:14:40 - pager triggers and SRE paged
- 09:17:10 - policy-913-override applied
- 09:18:30 - error rates declining

qa-bot: adding log excerpt showing tokenizer boundary diff:
```
request_id: xyz-789
prompt: "Summarize this in one line.\n"
rw-2b tokens: ['Summarize',' this',' in',' one',' line','.','\\n']
rw-2a-lite tokens: ['Summarize this in one line','\\n']
response_rw-2b: "One-line summary.\n"
response_rw-2a-lite: "One-line summary"  // missing terminating newline -> caller parse fails
```

diego: this explains the parser-level errors. we need to ensure function-call and structured output routes retain family-preserving fallback.

amar: comms note sent to affected customers with mitigation summary and temporary workaround. support is patching some of the callers to accept missing trailing newline as graceful default while we fix router.

nora: postmortem action items (assign):
- diego: revert/patch scoring PR + add tokenizer-family unit tests (ETA 3d)
- amar: autoscaler tuning RFC and faster prewarm for dedicated pools (ETA 2w)
- qa-bot: add compatibility suite to CI gating for routing changes (ETA 1w)
- support-bot: follow-up outreach and SLA credit assessment (ETA 2d)

oncall-ams: standing down from direct pager but available for follow-ups. good cross-team work.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED - pager #4332 mitigation applied; monitoring. next update in 15m.

amar: leaving note: keep policy-913-override until we've validated the scoring revert in canary. if any team sees error >5% for premium in eu-central re-alert immediately.

nora: adding evidence to incident folder and saving logs (window 09:10-09:30 UTC). will compile final RCA draft after stability window.

incident-bot: INCIDENT MONITORED - will auto-close after RCA uploaded.
